slots.text: This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:
Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

slots.text: You keep achieving — and still feel a quiet unease you can't quite name.
Your calendar is full, but the days pass without leaving a mark.
You've tried it all, but something still hasn't clicked.
You look successful on paper, but the life doesn't feel like yours.

A calmer, steadier rhythm — one that makes rest feel possible instead of performative, and allows you to slow down without guilt. Clear boundaries and softer self-expectations, so your energy stops leaking into things that don't matter, and stays with what truly supports you.

A way of working and resting that truly supports you — not just for the next deadline, but for the long run. A steadier rhythm that helps you feel more balanced, focused, and at ease in your everyday life. Through simple, thoughtful practices, you'll gently return to yourself — creating small daily rituals that bring steadiness to your days.
Ready to find what's missing? Let's talk it through.

Step away without needing to justify it.

slots.text: Is coaching the same as therapy?
No. We work with the present and the possible. If deeper clinical work is needed, I'll say so and help you find the right person.
By video, from wherever you are. Occasionally in person in Lisbon by arrangement.
What if I'm not sure I need this?
That's what the first conversation is for. It's complimentary and honest — no pressure to continue.
Everything shared stays between us. Notes are minimal and never shared with third parties.
When will I start seeing results?
Most clients notice a shift within three to four sessions — clearer perspective, better boundaries, more decisive action.
No forms to fill in advance. Just a short reply, a few honest lines, and we'll find a time that suits.
